Definition: One piece of free-form text the user writes, saved with an automatic date and time and zero or more tags.
All thoughts in one place, either the linked gist or this device, shown newest first.
A short label on a thought, used to filter and search the log.
The GitHub gist the user chose to keep gist thoughts in.
The GitHub personal access token the user pastes in so the app can read and write their linked gist.
Thoughts saved in a local file on this device that is never committed, kept apart from the thoughts in a gist.
